name: Turn-Based Tactics
description: Grid combat where the turn is a budget and position is the argument: initiative orders the units, action points price their verbs, the grid prices their steps, and cover prices their mistakes. TypeChart ships here and is shared forward with the Monster Taming pack. Status Effects now adds restore-safe refresh, stacking, cleanse, and immunities; Grid Movement Range can optionally apply movement multipliers, roots, and attack restrictions without acquiring AP, turn, pathfinding, or roster ownership.
loop: scout → position units → action economy per turn → objective

signatureCompound.name: The Turn Loop
signatureCompound.description: turn_order_queue announces whose turn it is, action_point_economy hands them a budget, grid_movement_range shows where the budget walks, and cover_bonus_grid prices every shot taken along the way. One full turn through these four is the entire genre in miniature.
